mechanism: Approach one subject as an unplanned discovery, follow an ordinary route through recurring spatial landmarks, let one visible cue redirect attention, receive one restrained acknowledgment, then preserve operator imperfection during continued departure.

invariants.rule: Begin with discovery of a subject already in an ordinary route.
Use recurring landmarks to maintain one geography.
Let one visible cue redirect attention.
invariants.ablation_failure: An unexplained reaction has no trigger.

invariants.rule: End with departure and mild operator imperfection.
invariants.ablation_failure: A flawless finish erases the observer.

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair with a readable role.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.

anti_copy_exclusions: the source woman, basket and wardrobe
